topic:
Big News! 🎉

First award for Tarang Plus is here!

Our film _The Supar Hero_ won Best Use of Technology (Jury Spl Mention) at National Level Short Film Festival - Samarthya 2026.

Hearty Congratulations to the entire Team Tarang Plus! 🙏
caption:
We took some big creative risks with the tech on *The Supar Hero*, mostly because we wanted to prove that regional storytelling doesn't have to play small. 

This Jury Special Mention for Best Use of Technology at Samarthya 2026 is a massive win for everyone at Tarang Plus who stayed up nights pushing pixels. First of many. Well done, team.

#TheSuparHero #TarangPlus #OdiaCinema #Samarthya2026
